settings.code: Microcurrent technology has clinically proven benefits that deliver both immediate and cumulative results.

Microcurrent is a type of low-level electrical current that is commonly used in medical and cosmetic applications. Microcurrent devices typically use a very low voltage and amperage, often less than one milliampere.

In the beauty industry, microcurrent is often used for facial toning and rejuvenation. The electrical current is applied to the skin with a small handheld device that delivers a series of gentle impulses to the facial muscles, helping to lift, firm, and tighten the skin. The treatment is non-invasive and requires no downtime. It has been clinically tested therapy for decades and is a safe technology for skincare

How does Microcurrent Treatment work?

Microcurrent treatment provides gentle waves through skin tissues and muscles, which does not hurt, giving you a healthy and younger-looking beauty treatment instantly. The currents are typically delivered using small, handheld probes or pads placed on the skin's surface. The electrical impulses help the tightened muscle relax and regain strength for under-tightened muscles. When used on the face, it helps to lift the face.

What is a Microcurrent Facial Treatment?

Microcurrent facial treatment is a non-invasive cosmetic procedure and is an alternative to Botox. It is a popular choice for beauty treatment as it is painless and has no downtime. It uses a specialized microcurrent machine with low-level electrical currents to stimulate the facial, neck, and other body muscles. The electrical currents used in microcurrent for facial treatment are very mild and are similar to the intensity of the natural electrical impulses produced by the body's cells.

settings.title: Improved Muscle Tone
settings.text: Microcurrent therapy can help stimulate the underlying muscles in the skin, leading to improved muscle tone and a lifted, more youthful appearance. Microcurrent technology also helps relax muscles and improve circulation, benefiting those with muscle tension or spasms.

settings.title: REDUCED LINE FINES & WRINKLES
settings.text: The low-level electrical currents used in microcurrent treatments stimulate the muscles and tissues beneath the skin, which stimulates the production of collagen and elastin; this therapy can help to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles on the skin.

settings.title: Improved SKIN HYDRATION
settings.text: Microcurrent therapy can help improve skin care product absorption, which can help increase hydration and improve the skin's overall health and also promotes the healing of wounds and injuries by increasing blood flow and stimulating cellular regeneration.

settings.title: Improved circulation & lymphatic drainage
settings.text: This therapy can help increase circulation and lymphatic drainage, reducing puffiness and improving skin health which can help reduce swelling and inflammation.

settings.title: Relaxation and stress reduction
settings.text: Microcurrent treatments can help stimulate the release of endorphins, leading to a greater sense of relaxation and reduced stress. Microcurrent technology has been found to have a calming effect on the nervous system leading to better sleep quality and more restful nights.
